snippet.title: 13 BONES - Play spicy black-jack with cursed cards to earn your freedom!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://solroo.itch.io/13-bones?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt You are an unnamed skeleton soldier, a minion among many.

Play 13 BONES (spicy black-jack, with cursed cards) to earn your freedom.
The cursed cards make you go BUST instantly if you play 3 of the same cursed symbol.

➡️ More from Joan Sol Roo https://solroo.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
